note: A1+ Unit 2 Lesson 2.11, built on 2026-11-20 under the A1+ lesson standards approved 2026-10-27 and the user's 2026-11-09 rule that every A1+ lesson follows up the A1 lesson with the same number. The user approved the A1+ Unit 2 plan on 2026-11-19 (A1+ 2.Y follows A1 2.Y, one grammar step each) and chose "Straight to Preview": no per-lesson gates, Gemini 2.5 Flash photos and ElevenLabs audio pre-approved, reviewed in Preview. Batch C (2.11-2.15) was started on 2026-11-20 on the user's "Start Batch C when Preview is done". Each photo shows two people or two things side by side, so the comparison can be seen at once: Sofia beside Luis (A1+ 1.1), Luis with his older brother and with his younger brother (A1+ 1.5, Luis speaks), a long bus beside a small car, a big brown dog beside a small white dog and a grandfather beside a boy. Sentence banks keep the sentence and change only the comparative; Who/Which questions are answered with the person or thing (Which dog is bigger? The brown one., A1+ 2.10). The two-dog sentences have nine words, so they stay out of Speak and Use. No photo goes into a four-picture card, because each shows two things across the frame.

lesson.title: 2.11 Taller than Sofia
lesson.unit_title: Places, things and how we describe them
lesson.unit_outcome: Say where people go and how they get there, talk about the things people have, point things out and compare them, put things in order, and ask about favorites.
lesson.goal: Compare two people or two things with -er than (Luis is taller than Sofia. / The bus is bigger than the car. / I am older than my brother.).
lesson.grammar_function: A follow-up of A1 2.11 Big and Small: A1 says It is a big dog. / It is a small dog. about one thing at a time; A1+ 2.11 compares two in one photo with the -er form and than (The brown dog is bigger than the white dog.). big doubles its g (bigger). It brings back A1+ 1.1's tall, short, old and young and 1.5's older and younger, now with than (My brother is older than me.). Two people or two things share each photo: Sofia beside Luis (1.1), Luis with his older and his younger brother (1.5), a bus beside a car, a big brown dog beside a small white dog, and a grandfather beside a boy on a bench.
lesson.prerequisite: A1 2.11 big, small; A1+ 1.1 tall, short, old, young; A1+ 1.5 older, younger, my brother; A1 2.2 bus, car; A1 1.10 dog; A1 brown, white; A1+ 2.10 the brown one; A1 2.12 or.
lesson.speaking_outcome: Say than with a soft th and a weak vowel (thən), linked to the comparative (TALLer than). Do not require native-like speed.
